arxiv-2101-05118.title: Common envelope jets supernovae with a black hole companion as possible high energy neutrino sources
arxiv-2101-05118.creator: Aldana Grichener, Noam Soker
arxiv-2101-05118.description: Abstract We study high energy neutrino emission from relativistic jets launched by a black hole (BH) spiraling-in inside the envelope of a red supergiant (RSG), and find that such common envelope jets supernovae (CEJSNe) are a potential source for the ≳ 10 15 ​ eV \gtrsim 10^{15}~\rm{eV} neutrinos detected by IceCube.

arxiv-2101-07163.title: Modeling ice crystal growth using the lattice Boltzmann method Journal: …
arxiv-2101-07163.creator: Q. Tan, S.A. Hosseini, A. Seidel-Morgenstern, D. Thévenin, H. Lorenz
arxiv-2101-07163.description: Abstract Given the multitude of growth habits, pronounced sensitivity to ambient conditions and wide range of scales involved, snowflake crystals are one of the most challenging systems to model. The present work focuses on the development and validation of a coupled flow/species/phase solver based on the lattice Boltzmann method.

arxiv-2111-10160.title: Kodaira–Spencer isomorphisms and degeneracy maps on Iwahori-level Hilbert modular varieties: the saving trace
arxiv-2111-10160.creator: Fred Diamond
arxiv-2111-10160.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fred Diamond. We consider integral models of Hilbert modular varieties with Iwahori level structure at primes over p p , first proving a Kodaira–Spencer isomorphism that gives a concise description of their dualizing sheaves. We then analyze fibres of the degeneracy maps to Hilbert modular varieties of level prime to p p and deduce the vanishing of higher direct images of structure and dualizing sheaves, generalizing prior work with Kassaei and Sasaki (for p p unramified in the totally real field F F ).

arxiv-2204-09839.title: 6GAN: IPv6 Multi-Pattern Target Generation via Generative Adversarial Nets with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2204-09839.creator: Tianyu Cui 1,2 , Gaopeng Gou(✉) 1,2 , Gang Xiong 1,2 , Chang Liu 1,2 , Peipei Fu 1,2 and Zhen Li 1,2
arxiv-2204-09839.description: Abstract Global IPv6 scanning has always been a challenge for researchers because of the limited network speed and computational power. Target generation algorithms are recently proposed to overcome the problem for Internet assessments by predicting a candidate set to scan. However, IPv6 custom address configuration emerges diverse addressing patterns discouraging algorithmic inference.

arxiv-2311-10579.title: Graph Neural Networks for Pressure Estimation in Water Distribution Systems
arxiv-2311-10579.creator: Huy TruongBernoulli InstituteUniversity of GroningenGroningen, The Netherlands h.c.truong@rug.nl, Andrés TelloBernoulli InstituteUniversity of GroningenGroningen, The Netherlands andres.tello@rug.nl Alexander LazovikBernoulli InstituteUniversity of GroningenGroningen, The Netherlands a.lazovik@rug.n
arxiv-2311-10579.description: Abstract Pressure and flow estimation in Water Distribution Networks (WDN) allows water management companies to optimize their control operations. For many years, mathematical simulation tools have been the most common approach to reconstructing an estimate of the WDN hydraulics. However, pure physics-based simulations involve several challenges, e.g. partially observable data, high uncertainty, and extensive manual configuration.

arxiv-2405-01502.title: Analyzing the Role of Semantic Representations in the Era of Large Language Models
arxiv-2405-01502.creator: Zhijing Jin, Yuen Chen, Fernando Gonzalez, Jiarui Liu, Jiayi Zhang, Julian Michael, Bernhard Schölkopf, Mona Diab
arxiv-2405-01502.description: Abstract Traditionally, natural language processing (NLP) models often use a rich set of features created by linguistic expertise, such as semantic representations. However, in the era of large language models (LLMs), more and more tasks are turned into generic, end-to-end sequence generation problems.

arxiv-2405-15107.title: Is Algorithmic Stability Testable? A Unified Framework under Computational Constraints
arxiv-2405-15107.creator: Yuetian Luo, Rina Foygel Barber
arxiv-2405-15107.description: Abstract Algorithmic stability is a central notion in learning theory that quantifies the sensitivity of an algorithm to small changes in the training data. If a learning algorithm satisfies certain stability properties, this leads to many important downstream implications, such as generalization, robustness, and reliable predictive inference.

arxiv-2408-14967.title: Hartree-Fock approximation for non-Coulomb interactions in three and two-dimensional systems
arxiv-2408-14967.creator: Vlad-Mihai Ene, Ilinca Lianu and Ioan Grosu
arxiv-2408-14967.description: Abstract We analyzed the Hartree-Fock approximation for an electron system. The interaction between particles is modeled by a non-Coulombian potential. We analyzed both the three-dimensional and two-dimensional systems. We obtained accurate analytical results for the particle energy, the particle velocity, the ground state energy of the system as well as the momentum dependent density of states.

arxiv-2503-00854.title: FACROC: a fairness measure for FAir Clustering through ROC curves
arxiv-2503-00854.creator: Tai Le Quy, Long Le Thanh, Lan Luong Thi Hong, Frank Hopfgartner
arxiv-2503-00854.description: Abstract Fair clustering has attracted remarkable attention from the research community. Many fairness measures for clustering have been proposed; however, they do not take into account the clustering quality w.r.t. the values of the protected attribute. In this paper, we introduce a new visual-based fairness measure for fair clustering through ROC curves, namely FACROC.

arxiv-2505-20357.title: Learning and Interpreting Gravitational-Wave Features from CNNs with a Random Forest Approach
arxiv-2505-20357.creator: Qingquan Jiang
arxiv-2505-20357.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have attracted increasing attention in gravitational wave (GW) data analysis due to their ability to automatically learn hierarchical features from raw strain data. However, the physical meaning of these learned features remains underexplored, limiting the interpretability of such models.

arxiv-2509-02788.title: Some Maker-Breaker games on graphs/hypergraphs
arxiv-2509-02788.creator: Patrick Bennett, Alan Frieze, Wesley Pegden
arxiv-2509-02788.description: Abstract We consider some biased Maker-Breaker games. Starting with the complete k k -uniform hypergraph on n n vertices, at each turn Maker claims one edge, and then Breaker claims b b edges. Maker’s goal is to obtain a set of edges having some increasing property.

arxiv-2509-22966.title: When is the canonical conductor minimal?
arxiv-2509-22966.creator: Özgür Esentepe
arxiv-2509-22966.description: Abstract . For a one dimensional analytically unramified local domain R R , the blowup algebra of the canonical ideal is a birational extension. The conductor of this extension always contains the conductor of R R . We study the case when there is equality and we classify numerical semigroups with this property.

arxiv-2509-24339.title: de Sitter Corrections to Gravitational Wave Memory
arxiv-2509-24339.creator: Anthi Voulgari Revof, Shubhanshu Tiwari
arxiv-2509-24339.description: Abstract In this work, we compute the gravitational wave displacement and spin memory effects in de Sitter spacetime. Gravitational waves in asymptotically flat spacetimes are described by the Bondi–Sachs framework, where radiation at null infinity ℐ + \mathscr{I}^{+} is tied to the BMS group, and memory appears as permanent changes in the geometry.

europmc-pmc9252834.title: SynergyFinder 3.0: an interactive analysis and consensus interpretation of multi-drug synergies across multiple samples.
europmc-pmc9252834.creator: Ianevski A, Giri AK, Aittokallio T.
europmc-pmc9252834.description: SynergyFinder (https://synergyfinder.fimm.fi) is a free web-application for interactive analysis and visualization of multi-drug combination response data. Since its first release in 2017, SynergyFinder has become a popular tool for multi-dose combination data analytics, partly...

mill-principles-political-economy-1848-v.creator: John Stuart Mill
mill-principles-political-economy-1848-v.description: Mill's 1848 Principles — the great Victorian synthesis of classical political economy. Volume 1 of 2.

plos-pone-0010655.creator: Daniel L. J. Thorek, Patricia Y. Tsao, Vaishali Arora et al.
plos-pone-0010655.description: PLOS ONE research article. B cell depletion immunotherapy has been successfully employed to treat non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. In recent years, increasing attention has been directed towards also using B-cell depletion therapy as a treatment option in autoimmune disorders. However, it appears that the further d

pmc-10615337.title: Infection à Mycobacterium bovis disséminée se manifestant par une adénite cervicale chez une jeune fille de 15 ans
pmc-10615337.creator: Dara Petel, Valerie Waters, Ian Kitai
pmc-10615337.description: on soudaine. La radiographie pulmonaire a révélé des opacités interstitielles et respiratoires bilatérales disséminées, des nodules et un granulome calcifié dans le lobe supérieur droit.

pmc-11478630.title: Postural Risks in Dental Practice: An Assessment of Musculoskeletal Health
pmc-11478630.creator: Alexandra Maria Lazăr (Căteanu), Angela Repanovici, Mihaela Ioana Baritz, Mihaela Monica Scutariu, Anca Ioana Tătaru (Ostafe), Ileana Pantea
pmc-11478630.description: In recent years, Romania’s stomatology private practice sector has seen substantial growth, with many dentists fully committing to building and expanding their own practices, often funded by their personal income. This study aimed to explore how various postures affect the muscle groups of dentists (380), particularly focusing on identifying positions that may jeopardize their musculoskeletal health.

pmc-11736372.title: Efficient gene editing of pig embryos by combining electroporation and lipofection
pmc-11736372.creator: Qingyi Lin, Nanaka Torigoe, Bin Liu, Yuichiro Nakayama, Aya Nakai, Zhao Namula, Megumi Nagahara, Fuminori Tanihara, Maki Hirata, Takeshige Otoi
pmc-11736372.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background and Aim:Mosaicism, which is characterized by the presence of wild-type and more than one mutant allele, poses a serious problem in zygotic gene modification through the clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeat (CRISPR)/CRISPR-associated protein 9 system. Therefore, we used pig embryos to compare the gene editing efficiencies achieved by combining electroporation and lipofection using different aminopeptidase N (APN)-targeting guide RNA (gRNA) sequences.Materials and Methods:Six gRNAs (gRNA1–6) with different target sequences were designed to target APN.

pmc-12560680.title: Protective Role of the Sodium Taurocholate Cotransporting Polypeptide S267F Variant Against Hepatitis B Virus Infection and Cirrhosis in the Vietnamese Population
pmc-12560680.creator: Pham Xuan Huy, Le Chi Cao, Dao Thi Huyen, Tran Thi Thu Hien, Truong Nhat My, Tran Thi Thanh Huyen, Le Huu Song, Thirumalaisamy P. Velavan, Nguyen Linh Toan
pmc-12560680.description: The sodium taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide (NTCP) serves as both a hepatic bile acid transporter and an essential entry receptor for hepatitis B virus (HBV). The S267F (rs2296651) polymorphism in the NTCP gene has been associated with reduced HBV susceptibility in East Asian populations. However, its clinical relevance in the Vietnamese population remains underexplored.

pmc-12599693.title: Development of a nomogram model for predicting pulmonary tuberculosis activity
pmc-12599693.creator: Xiaoyan Wu, Gonghui Wang, Hang Wang, Nana Li, Quanxian Liu
pmc-12599693.description: Timely and accurate identification of active pulmonary tuberculosis (APTB) is essential for effective treatment and public health control. This study aimed to develop a predictive nomogram using routine laboratory parameters to distinguish APTB from non-active pulmonary tuberculosis. A retrospective observational study was conducted at a single tertiary hospital from January 2021 to December 2024.

pmc-13052074.title: ECPR In Penetrating Chest Trauma With Thoracic Aortic Injury: A Case Report
pmc-13052074.creator: Xiang Gao, Linzi Jin, Yan Li
pmc-13052074.description: Cardiac arrest due to severe chest trauma with thoracic aortic injury presents a significant challenge in emergency medicine. Extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation (ECPR) offers a potentially lifesaving intervention for such cases. We report a case of a 22‐year‐old male who sustained an open chest trauma with thoracic aortic injury from a stab wound, resulting in cardiac arrest.

pmc-13056997.title: Copper-catalysed dynamic kinetic (4+1) cyclization of 1,3-enynes for atroposelective arylpyrrole synthesis
pmc-13056997.creator: Ya-Jun Zhong, Xiaoli Ren, Ting Qi, Ronggen Zhong, Qian Liu, Lei Hu, Wei Huang, Cheng Peng, Jun-Long Li, Bo Han, Gu Zhan
pmc-13056997.description: Axially chiral arylpyrroles are a promising class of compounds with broad applications in catalysis, medicinal chemistry, and materials science. Herein, we report a copper-catalysed dynamic kinetic asymmetric (4 + 1) cyclization for the atroposelective synthesis of arylpyrroles bearing a single stereogenic axis or 1,2-diaxes from 1,3-enynes and amines.

pmc-13315694.title: Nudging Toward Sustainable and Healthy Diets: A Randomized Trial of Young Adults
pmc-13315694.creator: Carmen E Prestemon, Anna H Grummon, Sarah M Frank, Checkna Diawara, Lindsey Smith Taillie
pmc-13315694.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundYoung adulthood is an optimal time for intervening in dietary behaviors. pmc-13482798.title: Surrogacy from a reproductive rights and justice perspective: a narrative review
pmc-13482798.creator: Margot Lherbet, Samir Hamamah
pmc-13482798.description: Graphical Abstract AbstractSurrogacy is a form of assisted reproductive technology in which a woman carries a child on behalf of an individual or couple and relinquishes the child following birth. Since its emergence in its contemporary form in the late 1970s, surrogacy has been the subject of ongoing debate and controversy, shaped by developments in scientific research and social discourse.

pmc-13556514.title: 386. Comparative efficacy of EEG-based neurofeedback as an alternative or adjunct to pharmacological treatment in patients with ADHD and psychiatric comorbidities
pmc-13556514.creator: AJ Ballinas Reyes
pmc-13556514.description: BackgroundAttention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is associated with dysfunction of fronto-striatal and fronto-parietal circuits, as well as electroencephalographic abnormalities characterized by an increased theta/beta ratio. Pharmacological treatment primarily modulates dopaminergic and noradrenergic neurotransmission; however, its effectiveness may be limited in the presence of psychiatric comorbidities and by adverse effects.

pmc-13697938.title: Piezocatalytic Therapy for Periodontitis: From Biofilm Disruption to Immunomodulatory Tissue Regeneration
pmc-13697938.creator: Shiqi Tian, Zihao Wang, Dawei Gao, Anshuo Li
pmc-13697938.description: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease characterized by an interplay between microbial dysbiosis and dysregulated host immune responses. Traditional therapies, including scaling and root planing combined with localized antimicrobial administration, often struggle with the drug resistance of structured biofilms and persistent inflammation.

uslaw-usc-t44-s2206.title: 44 U.S.C. § 2206 — Regulations
uslaw-usc-t44-s2206.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t44-s2206.description: United States Code, Title 44 (Public Printing And Documents); Chapter 22 (Presidential Records). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Archivist shall promulgate in accordance with section 553 of title 5, United States Code, regulations necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter. Such regulations shall include— (1) provisions for advance public notice and description of any Presidential records scheduled for disposal.
